parameters.content:
## Setup before activating
1. Create an n8n credential of type "Header Auth" named to match "Anthropic API Key (x-api-key header)": header name `x-api-key`, value = your Anthropic API key. Attach it to "Claude: Draft Caption Line" (replaces `REPLACE_WITH_ANTHROPIC_CREDENTIAL_ID`).
2. Model is `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` — cheapest/fastest, plenty for a 15-word caption line. Swap the `model` field in that node's JSON body if you want a different one.
3. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` in "Append to Google Sheet" with the shared sheet's ID.
4. Attach a real Google Sheets OAuth2 credential (replaces "Google Sheets account" placeholder).
5. Sheet must have a tab named "Content Drafts" with header row: date | artist | caption | hashtags | image links | posted?
6. In Directus, wire the `pieces` collection create/publish Flow to POST to this webhook's URL:
   `{n8n_base_url}/webhook/content-draft`
   Body: { artistName, service, styles[], images[], dateCompleted }
7. Hashtags and the image reminder line stay template-generated (deterministic, on-brand). Only the first caption line is AI-drafted by Claude — if the call fails or errors, "Assemble Row" falls back to the plain template automatically.
8. No auto-post to IG — this only drafts the row. Human copies caption + posts manually.

Ollama was considered first (free/local) but dropped — this Coolify host has no GPU, and CPU-only inference isn't worth it for a task this small. Claude Haiku is cheap enough per-call that it doesn't matter (one call per new piece published).
